idea-plugin.name: DeepSeek Harness
idea-plugin.description:
English

One job only: send the code you selected in IntelliJ IDEA to the DeepSeek Harness window you already have open, in the fixed reference format @/path/File.kt#L10-20.

The plugin does not start, embed, or manage any DSH process — no Node.js path, no provider API keys, no embedded browser. It writes one small JSON file into ~/.dsh/idea-bridge/inbox, and the companion DeepSeek Harness plugin dsh-idea-bridge puts that reference into the composer of the session bound to your project (and submits it, if you want).

How to use

  1. Install the companion dsh-idea-bridge plugin into your DeepSeek Harness profile (see dsh-idea-bridge/README.md) and restart DeepSeek Harness.
  2. Open your project in DeepSeek Harness (desktop client or the web UI) — the session whose working directory is that project receives the references.
  3. In IDEA, select code and press Ctrl+Alt+K (or right-click → Send Selection to DSH). No selection sends a whole-file reference.

Behaviour

  • Pre-fills the DeepSeek Harness input box and leaves it there — you add your question and press Enter. Turn on Submit the message automatically in Settings → Tools → DeepSeek Harness if you want it sent immediately.
  • If anything goes wrong, the reference is copied to the clipboard so nothing is lost.
  • Bilingual UI (English / 简体中文).

中文

只做一件事：把你在 IntelliJ IDEA 中选中的代码，以固定引用格式 @/path/File.kt#L10-20 发送到你已经打开着的 DeepSeek Harness 窗口。

插件不再启动、内嵌或管理任何 DSH 进程——不需要 Node.js 路径、不需要服务商 API Key、 也不再内嵌浏览器。它只往 ~/.dsh/idea-bridge/inbox 写一个很小的 JSON 文件， 由配套的 DSH 插件 dsh-idea-bridge 把这条引用写进"当前项目对应会话"的输入框 （按你的设置决定是否直接提交）。

使用方法

  1. 先在你的 DeepSeek Harness profile 里安装配套插件 dsh-idea-bridge （见 dsh-idea-bridge/README.md）并重启 DeepSeek Harness。
  2. 在 DeepSeek Harness（桌面客户端或网页）里打开同一个项目——工作目录与该项目的 会话会接收引用。
  3. 在 IDEA 中选中代码，按 Ctrl+Alt+K（或右键 → 发送选中代码到 DSH）。 没有选区时发送整文件引用。

行为说明

  • 默认只把引用填进 DeepSeek Harness 输入框，你自己补一句话再回车；需要立即发送就在 设置 → Tools → DeepSeek Harness 勾上"自动提交"。
  • 任何环节失败都会把引用复制到剪贴板，保证内容不丢。
  • 中英双语界面。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
English / 中文

v1.1.0

  • Draft by default: the reference is placed in the DeepSeek Harness input box and left there — you add your question and press Enter. Auto-submit is now an opt-in setting. 默认只填输入框（草稿），你自己补话再回车；自动提交改为需要手动开启。
  • Strict project routing: a reference is delivered only to the session whose working directory equals the project root, and when there is none the plugin now says so (with a clipboard fallback) instead of pretending it was sent. 严格项目路由：只投给工作目录等于项目根的会话；没有这样的会话时会明确提示（并回退剪贴板），不再"假成功"。

v2.0.0

  • Pivot to a single feature: send the editor selection to the DeepSeek Harness instance you already have open. The embedded web UI, the DSH process lifecycle, the IDE MCP endpoint, review/snapshot tooling, provider settings and credential sync are all removed (~7000 lines → ~600). 战略收敛为单一功能：把选中代码发送到你已经打开的 DeepSeek Harness。内嵌 Web UI、 DSH 进程管理、IDE MCP 端点、评审/快照、服务商配置与凭据同步全部删除（约 7000 行 → 约 600 行）。

v1.0.0

  • Initial release: embedded DeepSeek Harness web UI, send selection to DSH, review changes with diff, bilingual UI (English / 简体中文).
